changed_factors: Declare technique-owned prior_mechanism swapping task MoGParticlePrior for unstandardized ParticlePrior wrapped with NormalNoiseManipulator (sigma=0.005 on stochastic tasks, deterministic sigma=0.0 on enumerated particle-cloud image and discrete-vocabulary tasks)

Train clean by overriding recipe_overrides with output_noise_mode='fixed' and output_noise_std=0.0, matching public clean evaluation (sampling_law='public_prior_without_output_noise') and compelling generator Jacobian expansion to match target mode covariance

De-clock critic guard by overriding d_guard_ratio=0.0 and d_guard_min_steps=0 so the schedule-free dv12 continuous policy has zero fixed step-count releases while preserving unthrottled early critic acquisition
mechanism_rationale: MoG standardization couples all rows through batch/table moments, breaking feature-cell locality and independent birth/death transport. Replacing MoGParticlePrior with an unstandardized ParticlePrior plus an additive NormalNoiseManipulator (sigma=0.005, matched to the unclustered particle Voronoi cell scale so BoundedLatentGeometry sorted-rank neighbor windows stay intact) preserves strict identity row Jacobians (row_local_gradients=True, a2_eligible=True) and isolated prior_noise_generator draws, while removing the 200-step scheduled critic guard makes the full dv12 continuous policy strictly clock-free without throttling initial critic acquisition.
